english.title: Holder of provisional Passenger Carrying Vehicle licence fail to comply with condition of the licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a passenger carrying vehicle drivers licence issued as a provisional licence, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the prescribed conditions in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 114(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
